# E2E scenarios

<!-- Generated by scripts/ci/check_e2e_matrix.py from e2e/scenarios.json: do not edit; run `python3 scripts/ci/check_e2e_matrix.py write`. -->

Every user-visible behaviour has at least one happy and one bad scenario. The registry is `e2e/scenarios.json`; a test names the scenarios it covers with a Playwright tag `@S-…` or a `Scenarios: S-…` docstring line, and `scripts/ci/check_e2e_matrix.py` (static gate) checks both directions.
